events.blurb: Live coaching from XP League pros — skill drills, squad coordination, real-time feedback. Biweekly; next session August 19. Walk-ins welcome, all skill levels.

events.title: Switch Sports Day
events.subtitle: Bowling, tennis, volleyball — get off the keyboard and swing.
events.blurb: A full day of Nintendo Switch Sports on the big screen — bowling, tennis, volleyball, badminton, soccer, and chambara, all motion-controlled and easy to pick up. No PC experience needed; grab a controller and swing. At 5PM, an open Bowling Showdown — highest score in the room goes up on the board. Regular open play runs all day for everyone else.

events.title: XP League Fortnite Tournament
events.subtitle: Compete, win, and prove your build is better.
events.blurb: Bracket play with coached warm-up sets and live staff commentary. Biweekly; next tournament August 21. Walk-ins welcome; drop in and compete. Prize: $50 Newegg gift card to the tournament winner.

events.title: Marvel Day
events.subtitle: Rivals, Tokon, movies on the big screen, and comics to read.
events.blurb: A full Saturday of Marvel in every format. Stations running Marvel Rivals and Marvel Tokon side by side all day, Marvel films on the big screen from 12PM, and a comic lounge with longboxes out for anyone who'd rather read than play. Casual play, all skill levels, walk in any time.

events.blurb: Venue closed to the public for Intel Gamer Days setup.

events.title: Riot Thursday: Drop Day
events.subtitle: League and TFT all day — RP drops every hour.
events.blurb: League of Legends and Teamfight Tactics running side by side all day, with RP drops for players in the room every hour from 12PM to 6PM. Be in the building at the top of the hour to be eligible. Bring a squad or drop in solo — staff will get you into a lobby.

events.title: Anime Night
events.subtitle: Watch together. React together. All day.
events.blurb: All-day anime marathon with a community-voted lineup. Walk-ins welcome all day.

events.title: Rocket League Community Cup
events.subtitle: College club bracket on the big screen. Open play all day.
events.blurb: Confirmed college club teams play a school-vs-school 3v3 bracket 12PM–3PM, live on the main screen with staff or student commentary and the bracket posted on the board. Matches run five minutes, so the bracket moves fast and seats keep opening up. Open Rocket League lobbies run all day for everyone else — free either way, no roster required for open play. Spectators welcome; you don't have to play to watch.

events.title: XP League: Fortnite Training

events.blurb: Second training session of the biweekly cadence. Live coaching from XP League pros, all skill levels welcome.

events.title: TCG Thursday
events.subtitle: Bring your deck. Pull up a seat. Trade, battle, and open packs all day.
events.blurb: A full day for trading card game fans — tables set up for casual matches and trading, bring your own deck or borrow one at the desk. Regular open play runs alongside for everyone else.

events.title: XP League Fortnite Tournament
events.subtitle: Compete, win, and prove your build is better.
events.blurb: Second tournament of the biweekly cadence. Bracket play, coached warm-up sets, walk-ins welcome. Prize: $50 Newegg gift card to the tournament winner.

events.title: Coop Game Day
events.subtitle: Grab a partner and play together — no solo queue today.
events.blurb: A full day of couch and squad co-op — pick a partner or team up with whoever's around and play through co-op titles together. Staff can pair up walk-ins who came alone. Casual play, all skill levels.

events.title: Anime Night
events.subtitle: Watch together. React together. Free Japanese snacks while they last.
events.blurb: All-day anime marathon with a community-voted lineup — post the poll the week before and screen the winners. Free Japanese snacks (Pocky, ramune, Hi-Chew, shrimp chips) put out at 5PM while supplies last. Walk-ins welcome all day.

events.title: Game Jam: Day 1
events.subtitle: Build a game in two days. Submit it for a prize.
events.blurb: Kickoff of a two-day Game Jam. Sign up on the website in advance, then drop in to work on your game — solo or with a team. Staff and stations available all day; submissions are due by the end of Day 2 (8/28).

events.title: Game Jam: Day 2
events.subtitle: Final day. Finish your build and submit.
events.blurb: Final day of the two-day Game Jam. Finish your build, polish it up, and submit before close. Staff and stations available all day.

events.title: August Finale: Street Fighter Saturday Slam
events.subtitle: Run it back. Bracket play all day, one champion by close.
events.blurb: A full day of Street Fighter bracket play, open to all skill levels — drop in any time to enter the rotation. At 5PM, a recap of the month and the announcement of the Game Jam winner.
